title: The Legend of the Swamp — Part 1

series.summary: On Whale Island, twelve-year-old Gon Freecss dreams of taking the perilous Hunter Exam, but Aunt Mito forbids it unless he completes an impossible challenge: catching the mythical Lord of the Swamp. Perched in a giant tree with his father's rod, Gon battles the colossal monster fish and lands it before the stunned villagers, proving his unshakable resolve.

segments.voiceover_text: A twelve-year-old boy wagers his future on one impossible catch. Perched high above the swamp, Gon Freecss waits to earn his ticket to the deadly Hunter Exam.
Aunt Mito set an uncompromising rule: catch the mythical swamp monster, or stay home forever. Five grown fishermen failed. She prays the beast never bites.
Suddenly, the lake boils. The line snaps taut. The colossal creature thrashes, violently pulling Gon toward the water, but his grip never falters.
Gon wrenches the titanic beast onto the shore. The crowd is stunned. He won his ticket, but can he survive the painful secret Aunt Mito is hiding?
